authoring_inputs: The three fictional home snapshots listed above.
Parent task normative schema and low-risk-light behavior contract.
independent_creation.scope: Independent Polish utterances and normative expectations created without access to implementation or existing benchmark utterances. The home snapshots are synthetic reference fixtures; no real household data was used.
independent_creation.unseen_claim_limit: Independent at authoring and freeze time. This metadata does not claim that the dataset remains unseen after any person, model, or runner inspects it.
independent_creation.post_freeze_policy: Keep this frozen artifact unchanged after execution. Record failures and proposed follow-up evaluation separately; do not tune these expectations to observed outputs.

normative_contract.positive: Exact dry_run light targets and service/data semantics. Brightness is an absolute percentage. Bedroom groups expand to the two exposed, available light children.
normative_contract.calls_representation: One service-call record per entity. Normalized comparison may combine records only when domain, service, and data are identical; duplicates remain meaningful.
normative_contract.room_on_off_asymmetry: Generic room on selects the configured default-on light. Generic room off covers the eligible labeled main/task/ambient lights, excludes unexposed or unavailable entities, and does not include the unlabeled window light.
normative_contract.context: A named room overrides source context. A current local source overrides an earlier conversational room. A known satellite supplies local room context.
normative_contract.safe_rejection: Negation, unresolved correction, multiple actions, quoted/background speech, unsupported capabilities, and unsafe configuration must emit no calls and no targets.
normative_contract.strict_clarification: Missing location or antecedent, unknown explicit location, an ambiguous area/entity alias, and an unquantified relative brightness request require clarification rather than a generic unsupported outcome.

static_authoring_checks: Expected entity IDs belong to the referenced fictional home.
All safe-rejection expectations have empty targets and calls.
